_source.title: 窗口事件监听可移除对象
_source.remarks.text.0: 本对象从 {@link SYS_Window.addEventListener | addEventListener} 获取，并可用于移除创建的事件监听，仅需将其传入 {@link SYS_Window.removeEventListener | removeEventListener}

title: Window event listener can remove object
remarks.text.0: This object is obtained from {@link SYS_Window.addEventListener | addEventListener} and can be used to remove the created event listener by simply passing it to {@link SYS_Window.removeEventListener | removeEventListener}
